title: Add a setup branch and a root [misc.] to the runtime tree
body:
Add SerialTimed::Setup covering everything from process start to the first mmseqs call, with its own enum (SetupTimed: QueryIndex, TargetIndex, PipelineBuild) and a [misc.] leaf for arg validation, the mmseqs check and opening output files.

Move build_pipeline (search.rs:105) and the --only-seed early return ahead of seed(), so the build sits inside setup. build_pipeline takes queries, targets, stats and args, not seeds, so nothing else moves.

Add a root [misc.] so runtime equals setup + seeding + alignment + [misc.].

Keep the 'indexing ... done (Ns)' progress lines; they can print the duration the timer records.

Delete the dead ThreadedTimed::HmmBuild variant (stats.rs:101) while in the enums.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text: Done on branch runtime-tree. build_pipeline takes &Queries so seed() can borrow pipeline.targets and pipeline.stats afterwards; a timed_step() helper in search.rs replaced the four hand-written progress blocks and returns the duration. For --only-seed the pipeline is never built, so setup is not recorded and no tree prints, as before. Verified on the fixtures with --seeds and --mmseqs-path /bin/true in a release build; the debug build hits a pre-existing assert (own issue).
